evaluations.question: Which sales generated more than five hundred in revenue?

evaluations.question: Show the ten most recent sales.
evaluations.generated_sql:
SELECT T1.sale_id, T2.customer_name, T3.product_name, T4.employee_name, T5.quantity, T6.revenue, T7.order_date
FROM sales AS T1
JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id
JOIN products AS T3 ON T1.product_id = T3.product_id
JOIN employees AS T4 ON T1.employee_id = T4.employee_id
JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity * price) as revenue FROM orders GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10) AS T5 ON T1.product_id = T5.product_id
ORDER BY T7.order_date DESC;
